items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative, Exodus 32:7, KJV; reports what the LORD said, not independently verifiable)
items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
items.claim: The text reports that the LORD told Moses to go down because the people he had brought out of Egypt had corrupted themselves.
items.action: commanded Moses to go down and accused the people of corrupting themselves
items.object: Moses; the people brought out of Egypt

items.quote: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them:
items.claim: The text says the people quickly turned away from the way the LORD had commanded them.
items.action: turned aside from the commanded way
items.object: the way which the LORD commanded

items.quote: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto
items.claim: The text says the people made a molten (cast metal) calf, worshipped it, and offered sacrifices to it.
items.mechanism: casting a metal idol, followed by worship and sacrifice

items.quote: and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
items.claim: The text says the people declared that the calf was the god or gods who had brought Israel up out of Egypt.
items.action: proclaimed the calf as their gods and credited it with the Exodus
